decisions.reason: As a newly launched product closely tied to the firm’s proven space imaging and navigation business, with no visible sign of underperformance and in a growing, R&D-intensive market, it would likely be retained while results mature against aspiration levels.

Its modular navigation camera concept fits the firm’s strategic move toward more flexible spacecraft sensors, and a large established firm with organizational slack would likely keep it on the market while learning about demand and performance.

Because this sensor suite builds on the firm’s existing capabilities and serves adjacent customer needs, management would likely continue it rather than redeploy resources before clearer evidence shows it falls below aspirations.

Although it appears less prominently marketed, the miniaturized LiDAR sensor is still close to core competences and strongly aligned with the firm’s push toward compact space-qualified instruments, so a slack-rich firm would likely give it more time.
